text:
```yaml
name: Deploy Docs on Main Branch Commits

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - docs/**

permissions: {}

jobs:
  detect-docs-changes:
    name: Detect Docs Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      has_docs_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.docs }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Filter docs changes
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            docs:
              - 'docs/**'

  trigger-website-deploy:
    name: Trigger Website Deploy
    needs: detect-docs-changes
    if: needs.detect-docs-changes.outputs.has_docs_changes == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger Vercel Deploy Hook
        run: |
          curl -X POST "${{ secrets.WEBSITE_VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"ref": "main"}'
```
